name: pickup_send_pkt11_create_delta
description: Pickup::SendPkt11_CreateDelta sends a reliable pkt11 create/full-state pickup delta and frees the temporary packet buffer. Direct production host: RecoilApp.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup/GameNet source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433ea0 validates malloc of 0x34 bytes, zero initialization, packet type 0x11, packet size 0x34, local-player key at header+0x04, flag 1 at +0x08, pickup id at +0x0c, PickupTypeKeyTable::FindIndex(spawn->pickupType->logicalName) stored at +0x10, amount at +0x14, position copied to +0x18, rotation copied to +0x24, respawnDelay copied to +0x30, reliable send, and free.

The native smoke captures the reliable send buffer before the function frees it and verifies packet header, flags, pickup id, logical-name index, amount, position, rotation, respawn delay, zeroed reserved words, and packet size.
